"Taxi Driver", "The Godfather", (or... more plausible to envision how I might fit-in, "The Freshman".)

Some high school friends went to college there.  So I followed.  Slept in their dorm rooms, rent free.  Explored.  I met black-power separatist radicals, drag queens, weird hairy feminist chicks, faggots, The Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Lou Reed, John Turturro, Biz Markie, Peter Dinklage, Geraldo Rivera, Ralph Lauren, skinheads, jews, ...Andrea Dworkin!  In all cases... it was like meeting Bugs Bunny.   I was amazed, not critical.  Even my dog was friends with Rosie Perez's dog & Parker Posey's dog.

One day I was killing time between-runs as a Bike Messenger... & saw a gay acquaintence who made hilarious art.  He took photos of all sorts of people-- wearing his mother's out-of-style clothes & wigs.  He was carrying a small brown paper sack, which looked like his lunch.   I followed him, chatting, into a hospital.  He was dropping off a stool sample.   That's foreshadowing.   He probably had some hideous gay butthole disease.  A lot of drag queens & gays I initially thought were fun & harmless... soon died of AIDS, meth, booze, retardation.

That 'hospital' was actually The Gay Clinic in The Gay Neighborhood.  Most nyc medical facilities looked like Gotham City nightmares.  But that place was clean, shiny, new, efficient.   Because a bunch of rich gay white men in the 1980's & 1990's had died of AIDS... with no wives or children to inherit their wealth.  So they donated their $ to build the gay clinic.   But-- of course-- it was named-after a poor black Communist lesbian.

The gay artist said you didn't have to be gay to go there-- and it was much better than the other options.  I'm straight, so I had discovered a "life hack".  Another plus: ghetto blacks didn't want to go to a gay clinic!  Which made waiting in the lobby much more pleasant.  So I started going to the dental office there.

Then came Obama and Obamacare.   Which I could tell-- was going to be a big brown bag of shit.   My girlfriend pointed-out that I was earning so little money as a messenger (the rise of email had killed that job) that I could sign-up for Medicaid.   And I could still do-so for a limited time, before switching-over to Obamacare became mandatory.   This was that first year when the launch of the Obamacare website got screwed-up... and the Dems panicked that not enough people were enrolling.

I biked-over to the gay clinic to enroll in Medicaid.  Instead of the normal-looking medical professionals-- there was a scruffy lesbo campus activist with green hair at a folding table in the lobby.  Pushing Obamacare.   She said it was too late to sign-up for Medicaid.   I showed her that wasn't true.  The deadline was over a month away.  She grumbled, but brought me the application.  I filled it out.  I never got my Medicaid card in the mail.  I went back.  They had "accidentally" forgotten to enroll me.   Now I -had to- enroll in Obamacare, or nothing.  The lesbo had put her commie activism ahead of serving the patient... medical malfeasance.   But no recourse.  I signed-up for Obamacare.  My card came in the mail.  The gay clinic did not list the gay clinic as my primary provider.   The vindictive faggots had signed me up for Woodhull Hospital in darkest Bed-Stuy Brooklyn.  Wood-Hell.  Ghetto shithole.  

So I ignored all the Obamacare mail & phone calls.  They said I had to sign & mail-back contracts.  So I didn't.  I got a letter saying I had been dropped from Obamacare.   Good!      

Time went by.   Girlfriend broke-up with me. (Turns-out that her directing me toward Medicaid was her trying to do right by me, on her way out the door.)  I was young & healthy... didn't need to go to the doctor much, except for occasional broken bones.    But being single meant hooking-up with a procession of girls.   So I went back to the gay clinic-- for STD testing.   A vicious little scruffy faggot at the desk asked how I would pay.   I said cash.  The faggot looked-up my name in the computer-- and said I had Obamacare, so I would have to pay using Obamacare.    I said I didn't have it anymore.  S/h/it said the records showed I did-- and I would be committing "health care fraud" if I paid with cash instead of the Obamacare billing system.   I said, "You aren't a lawyer. I don't have Obamacare.  You're making a false allegation that I'm committing a crime."  They tested me.  They sent me Obamacare bills.  I ignored those.  I never went back to the gay clinic.

I haven't gone to any doctor since whatever-year-it-was Obamacare launched.   Including 'walking-off' a broken hip & a riding-out a scratched eyeball... by putting silicone sex lube under my eyelid to reduce the friction pain.  Certainly didn't get jabbed during covid.   Only dental visits-- paying cash at a private dentist.   I wonder how long I can hold-out.

NYC turned filthy & looted & fentanyl & crime-ridden.  The fun days ended.   I had one last friend there from the old days-- who came-out as a Cross-Dresser in his 40's, during Biden.   He seemed like someone the gay clinic would treat better.   So I told him to go there.   Which was a whole long mess.  When he first called (with his normal deep male voice), they said they weren't accepting new patients.  I checked their website-- and it specifically invited new patients in the "transgender community".  He was concerned that he was a "cross-dresser", not "transgender".  I said he was being an idiot: he's a faggot in a dress.  "Tell them you wear women's clothing."    They let him in.

He went to a weekly group therapy there for gender-whatever people.   He said they don't even try to look good.  (He looks terrible, but he tries.)  They got mad at him for saying it was good time to be gay or in drag... in the old-days they could be beat-up on the street.  The leader was an attractive female therapist.   But her "pronouns are he/they" & she kept scolding my friend for 'misgendering' her when he accidentally said 'she'.  He stopped going there.  But he kept doing the cross-dressing thing.  The old interests he & I once shared-- like rock music-- were gone.  He only cared about dressing up like a woman and fucking fags.  I didn't want to hear about it.  Less than a year after 'coming out', he got AIDS.  

The punchline to this long story is hardly worth the time it took to read it: gay culture isn't sophisticated or advanced.   It's seedy & intertwined with communism & doubling-down on mental illness.  And NYC is depleted.
